scope: representative initial space operations inventory; not exhaustive or market-share ranking
runtime_note: No provider requests or installations. Existing demo sgp4 usage is separate from verification of a new callable adapter.

tools.name: CelesTrak
tools.required_inputs: GP/OMM/TLE query criteria, objects and time range
tools.outputs: GP elements and catalog-related data
tools.documented_interface: Public HTTP downloads and queries, subject to usage policy
tools.limitations: Format compatibility does not improve orbital accuracy. GP elements must use the matching SGP4 model; operational covariance is not guaranteed.
tools.workflow_implication: Retrieve data, check epoch and element theory, then propagate with SGP4. These data alone do not establish high-accuracy maneuver screening.

tools.name: Space-Track
tools.required_inputs: Account, query permissions, objects and time criteria
tools.outputs: GP, historical data and related CDM products within authorized access
tools.documented_interface: Authenticated HTTP API; CDM products require appropriate permissions
tools.limitations: Public API documentation does not establish that the current account can access a particular spacecraft CDM. Verify rate limits and use restrictions.
tools.workflow_implication: Check product permissions and data coverage before requesting. Treat catalog elements and CDMs as distinct evidence types.

tools.name: ESA DISCOSweb
tools.required_inputs: Object identifiers and account/API access
tools.outputs: Object registration, launch and physical-property metadata
tools.documented_interface: Portal and API; exact fields and token requirements need integration verification
tools.limitations: Object metadata does not automatically establish an attitude-dependent hard-body radius (HBR) or current covariance.
tools.workflow_implication: Enrich object information with field-level provenance and missing-data flags; do not fabricate absent parameters.

tools.name: python-sgp4 / SGP4
tools.required_inputs: Compatible TLE/OMM GP elements and target epoch
tools.outputs: TEME position and velocity, with propagation error codes
tools.documented_interface: Python library; pin the underlying implementation and version
tools.limitations: Not a universal substitute for high-fidelity propagation. GP data do not supply operational covariance; frame conversion must be explicit.
tools.workflow_implication: Propagate with the matching GP theory, check epoch and errors, and convert frames when required. Missing covariance blocks quantitative Pc estimation.

tools.name: Orekit
tools.required_inputs: State, observations or CDM; frames and time scales; required EOP, gravity and celestial data; covariance and HBR for Pc
tools.outputs: Orbits, estimation results, transformations, geometric events and Pc under applicable assumptions
tools.documented_interface: Java API; actual bridge and deployment require verification
tools.limitations: Short-term two-dimensional Pc assumes conditions including linear relative motion and independent Gaussian position uncertainty. Record environmental data and calculation method.
tools.workflow_implication: Load environmental data, validate prerequisites, select propagation/estimation/Pc methods, and return versioned outputs with assumptions.

tools.name: Tudat / TudatPy
tools.required_inputs: Initial state, environment and force models, integration and termination settings; observations and estimated parameters for estimation
tools.outputs: State histories, variational-equation results, and parameter/state estimates
tools.documented_interface: Python interfaces with a C++ core
tools.limitations: Propagation and estimation support does not establish catalog screening or mission-constraint coverage.
tools.workflow_implication: Build the environment and dynamics, propagate or estimate, and retain residuals and configuration. Pc needs a separate capability.

tools.name: NASA GMAT
tools.required_inputs: Mission script, initial orbit, environment models, objectives and constraints
tools.outputs: Trajectories, optimization/targeting and analysis results
tools.documented_interface: GUI, mission scripts, Python and Java; verify modules in the selected version
tools.limitations: Mission design and navigation software is not itself an external conjunction catalog service. Verify API features by version.
tools.workflow_implication: Generate mission configuration, run it, check convergence and constraints, and export trajectories for independent screening.

tools.name: NAIF SPICE
tools.required_inputs: Kernels such as SPK/CK/PCK/FK/LSK covering the target and epoch, plus object and frame identifiers
tools.outputs: State, attitude, time/frame transformations and geometric events
tools.documented_interface: Toolkits for C, Fortran, IDL and MATLAB; third-party Python wrappers need separate verification
tools.limitations: Computes geometry from available kernels; does not automatically determine arbitrary spacecraft orbits or generate operational trajectories.
tools.workflow_implication: Check kernel types, versions and coverage, compute geometry, and retain the kernel manifest. Missing coverage blocks the calculation.

tools.name: Ansys STK / Astrogator
tools.required_inputs: Scenario, orbits, sensors and sites; engine models and constraints for maneuver design
tools.outputs: Visibility/contact windows, scenario analysis, and Astrogator trajectory/maneuver results
tools.documented_interface: STK Python API and Engine; Engine documentation supports Windows/Linux; module licenses required
tools.limitations: Verify installation, product modules and Engine entitlement. Geometric access does not mean a physical station is reserved.
tools.workflow_implication: Build the scenario, run analysis/targeting, and export results. Station reservation is a separate service step.

tools.name: Ansys ODTK
tools.required_inputs: Tracking observations, measurement models, initial state and uncertainty
tools.outputs: Filtering/estimation and orbital-uncertainty products
tools.documented_interface: Application automation; the referenced COM integration is Windows-specific; verify other deployments separately
tools.limitations: Requires observations and measurement-quality configuration. Do not transfer STK Python/platform support claims to ODTK.
tools.workflow_implication: Configure observations and priors, filter and check quality, then export orbit/covariance products for risk analysis.

tools.name: FreeFlyer
tools.required_inputs: Mission Plan/script, orbit or observations, and model settings
tools.outputs: Propagation, estimation and mission-analysis results
tools.documented_interface: Referenced Runtime API documents C/C++, C#, Java and Python; restricted to Mission tier in that reference
tools.limitations: Recheck documentation version, tier and current license. Local deployment and generic interchangeability have not been verified.
tools.workflow_implication: Generate a Mission Plan, invoke the licensed runtime, check exceptions and estimation/analysis quality, then extract results.

tools.name: Kayhan Dynamics
tools.required_inputs: State or observations and model configuration; exact interface schema to obtain
tools.outputs: Orbit simulation and estimation results; exact output contract to verify
tools.documented_interface: Official product page lists Managed API, SDK and local deployment
tools.limitations: Product descriptions do not establish endpoints, entitlement, accuracy or covariance fields. The page title says Elements while the body says Dynamics; verify naming.
tools.workflow_implication: Verify current interface, deployment and product access; configure computation; validate outputs and model/data versions.

tools.name: Kayhan SDK screening service (documented as Pathfinder)
tools.required_inputs: Account permissions, primary NORAD ID and ephemeris in a supported format
tools.outputs: Screening job identifier, completion status and conjunction results
tools.documented_interface: Public SDK/CLI documents upload, submission/waiting and queries; authentication configuration includes password and M2M modes
tools.limitations: Verify older product naming and interfaces. Historical catalog coverage and maneuver-planning API access are unconfirmed. Represent maneuver discontinuities in separate blocks.
tools.workflow_implication: Validate/upload ephemeris, submit, await/query and retrieve events. Changing screening providers requires checking the same time-window coverage.

tools.name: LeoLabs Collision Avoidance
tools.required_inputs: Operator ephemeris/object and authorization; actual job interface to verify
tools.outputs: CDMs/events, on-demand screening, secondary tracking and orbit/covariance-related products
tools.documented_interface: Official product material describes cloud services and a REST API
tools.limitations: Referenced product material is under a 2021 URL. Verify current schema/SLA, catalog population/coverage and historical support. Do not treat old timing claims as guarantees.
tools.workflow_implication: Submit compatible ephemeris, retrieve input-bound screening results and retain catalog/observation epochs. Additional tracking is a separate request with external effects.

tools.name: EU SST services
tools.required_inputs: Registration approval and service-specific operator configuration/orbit inputs
tools.outputs: CDMs, risk reports, re-entry and fragmentation-related products
tools.documented_interface: Portal; older official material describes REST access; verify current API contracts
tools.limitations: Free service still requires approval and configuration. Eligibility differs by service. Full-catalog bulk access is not established.
tools.workflow_implication: Confirm registration and service configuration, submit authorized trajectories or retrieve products, and involve the operations center for high-interest events.

tools.name: Basilisk
tools.required_inputs: Spacecraft, actuators, sensors, initial orbit/attitude, control algorithms and environment
tools.outputs: Coupled dynamics and attitude/actuator/control simulation histories
tools.documented_interface: Python configuration and C/C++ modules
tools.limitations: Not a ready-made catalog screener or flight-command authorization system. Fidelity depends on the selected models and parameters.
tools.workflow_implication: Insert a candidate maneuver into the spacecraft model, simulate actuator/attitude behavior, check feasibility and return the trajectory for renewed screening.

tools.name: Yamcs
tools.required_inputs: Deployed instance, mission database, telemetry links and user/command permissions
tools.outputs: Parameters/packets, alarms, events and command-status data
tools.documented_interface: HTTP JSON/Protobuf, WebSocket and a Python client
tools.limitations: Requires mission-specific database and links. Authorize read-only telemetry and command effects separately.
tools.workflow_implication: Read telemetry/alarms for analysis. Commands require explicit authority and mission review; successful computation does not automatically authorize uplink.

tools.name: OpenC3 COSMOS
tools.required_inputs: Target/packet definitions, plugins, interfaces and instance authentication
tools.outputs: Telemetry, limits/logs, commands and procedure-execution data
tools.documented_interface: HTTP JSON-RPC, scripts and WebSocket streaming; some interfaces are Enterprise-only
tools.limitations: Mission configuration is not generic plug-and-play. Documented methods that bypass checks do not grant Argus permission to use them.
tools.workflow_implication: Read mission-matched telemetry, analyze and draft procedures; execute procedures/commands only after separate permission checks.

tools.name: AWS Ground Station
tools.required_inputs: Configured/authorized satellite, mission profile, IAM, time window and covering ephemeris
tools.outputs: Contact opportunities, contact identifiers/status and associated data-transfer resources
tools.documented_interface: AWS API/SDK/CLI; documented TLE/OEM/azimuth-elevation workflows
tools.limitations: An available window does not guarantee reservation. Reservations affect resources and billing; check that the contact reaches SCHEDULED.
tools.workflow_implication: Validate ephemeris availability, list/select contacts, obtain reservation authority and confirm status or resolve conflicts. Recheck windows after trajectory changes.

tools.name: ESA DRAMA / MASTER
tools.required_inputs: Mission/spacecraft and orbit models, environmental data, software license and applicable version
tools.outputs: Debris flux, mitigation/disposal and re-entry analyses
tools.documented_interface: ESA software portal; DRAMA depends on MASTER; programmatic interface to verify
tools.limitations: Not a direct replacement for catalog screening of a current individual conjunction. Verify current license eligibility, models and standards versions.
tools.workflow_implication: Load environment/mission inputs, run applicable modules and interpret results under their models/standards. Regulatory compliance requires separate verification.
